method.sampling: Purposive 4-second windows at 6 fps, visually inspected in temporal order. This is not a prevalence census and does not measure exact camera velocity.
method.timing: Local reel seconds; dense sheet steps are 0.167 seconds. Scene map boundaries are semantic and approximate. CAM-01 ends9.8 and CAM-03 ends34.8 to exclude unrelated tail/cut.
method.ranking: Count distinct supported films, then distinct referenced semantic scenes. Repeated windows in one scene do not increase scene count. No frame-count weighting.
method.interpretation: Camera-state terms describe apparent motion relative to the subject. An orbit-like change can result from a rotating object or moving camera; zoom/scale/dolly are often indistinguishable. No original camera rig, focal length, isometric setting, velocity curve or percentage of moving footage is recovered.
method.splices: All sequence pairs checked against local/analysis/our-splices.json; none cross a local edit. CAM-03 evidence sheet includes our34.8348 splice in its final image, excluded from its interval/conclusions.

observations.description: An extreme oblique glass-numeral detail drifts gently, then cuts to a wider 9:41 construction. The wider shot continues a quiet lateral relative move; the depth and optical edges remain the subject.
observations.camera_state: slow relative drift; internal cut to a new viewpoint
observations.projection: Oblique dimensional rendering with foreshortening and occlusion; focal length and rig unknown.
observations.framing: cropped numeral rim → wider but still cropped clock
observations.motion_direction: features drift left in wider shot; no inferred dolly
observations.confidence: high for visible framing; medium for camera interpretation

observations.description: The dock is initially close and nearly frontal. After an internal cut around15.17, enlarged icons rapidly recede into a complete centered phone, then settle.

observations.motion_direction: apparent retreat toward center; screen upright

observations.motion_direction: lens right, then left/down; global image enlargement

sequence_pairs.relationship: Lateral menu survey switches into centered O enlargement; Finder then reopens lateral Dock travel. A pivot in movement type is bridged by a recognizable glyph.
Notification panel exits right while expanding context admits the calendar/desktop. Local object exit and global widening do different jobs without requiring a matching cut.
Retreat into a centered complete laptop slows before centered signature. Shared screen center, quiet endpoint and whitespace provide continuity across the cut.
The device view remains stable while Notifications gives way to a Messages task through home. Complement is consistency of outer framing, not a paired orbit.
Retreat from radius to form reverses into enlargement toward header arrow. The arrow survives the change to a yellow icon-grid scene, making the reversal purposeful.
Frontal component collection cuts to angled, drifting sample plates, then a held mark. Deliberate projection/motion contrast separates applications from material recap.
The stable page frame persists; the remaining dot becomes larger circular construction. Graphic subject continuity handles the chapter change without a world-space camera.
